open_questions: Q1 (declared): every Locked Decision is written in the form this phase makes checkable, so the shipped lint cannot verify them. Hand-verified against v0.146.1 by the orchestrating agent; D4 of deliverable 1 requires the post-phase lint to report non-zero over this same plan.

limitations: Makes the existing resolver run over statements nothing demands, and admits documentation extensions to the demand regex.
non_goals: No new parser -- parse_evidence_statements, resolve_line and reproduces already handle the mandated form and are not touched.

phases: Phase 1: resolve every statement, not only demanded ones -- tests/test_plan_grep_lint_statement_truth.py (NEW), qor/scripts/plan_grep_lint.py (check_citation_evidence adjudicates statement-only citations; count_truth_checked counts what was examined); tests test_a_statement_nothing_demands_is_still_resolved, test_a_true_statement_nothing_demands_reports_no_finding, test_truth_checked_counts_statement_only_citations, test_an_unresolvable_ref_is_not_reported_as_a_mismatch

Phase 2: admit documentation extensions -- qor/scripts/plan_grep_lint.py (_FILE_LINE_RE gains md, toml, json, yml, yaml); tests test_a_markdown_citation_demands_evidence, test_a_markdown_citation_paired_with_true_evidence_is_clean, test_the_two_path_regexes_agree_on_extensions

Phase 3: narrow the reported ceiling -- qor/references/doctrine-citation-pairing.md, qor/scripts/plan_grep_lint.py (PRESENCE_ONLY_KINDS), tests/test_doctrine_citation_pairing.py; tests test_doctrine_and_shipped_classification_agree (retargeted), test_the_reported_ceiling_names_grep_evidence_as_checked
